$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file.

description.description: The data pack's description, shown in the game's pack list (`pack.mcmeta`).
description.markdownDescription: The data pack's description, shown in the game's pack list (`pack.mcmeta`).

icon.description: A PNG in the project that becomes `pack.png` in both the data pack and the resource pack.
icon.markdownDescription: A PNG in the project that becomes `pack.png` in both the data pack and the resource pack.
icon.patternErrorMessage: The icon must be a .png file.

lint.description: Lint rule severities by rule id. Each rule can be `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint` or `off`.
lint.markdownDescription: Lint rule severities by rule id. Each rule can be `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint` or `off`.

book-overflow.description:
A Book page with more text than the book screen shows: 14 lines of about 19 characters. The game cuts the rest off. Widths are measured with the vanilla font, so text outside ASCII is a close guess.

Default: `warning`.
book-overflow.markdownDescription:
A Book page with more text than the book screen shows: 14 lines of about 19 characters. The game cuts the rest off. Widths are measured with the vanilla font, so text outside ASCII is a close guess.

Default: `warning`.

constant-expression.description:
An arithmetic expression of number literals can be written as its value.

Default: `hint`.
constant-expression.markdownDescription:
An arithmetic expression of number literals can be written as its value.

Default: `hint`.

custom-item-as-base.description:
A CustomItem used where the game takes a plain item id, such as a recipe ingredient or an item tag. It stands for its base item there, so it also matches the base item without the custom components.

Default: `hint`.
custom-item-as-base.markdownDescription:
A CustomItem used where the game takes a plain item id, such as a recipe ingredient or an item tag. It stands for its base item there, so it also matches the base item without the custom components.

Default: `hint`.

custom-item-base.description:
A CustomItem used where the game takes a plain item id, such as a recipe ingredient or an item tag. It stands for its base item there, so it also matches the base item without the custom components.

Default: `hint`.
custom-item-base.markdownDescription:
A CustomItem used where the game takes a plain item id, such as a recipe ingredient or an item tag. It stands for its base item there, so it also matches the base item without the custom components.

Default: `hint`.

deprecated.description:
A use of a declaration whose doc comment has a `@deprecated` tag.

Default: `warning`.
deprecated.markdownDescription:
A use of a declaration whose doc comment has a `@deprecated` tag.

Default: `warning`.

external-asset.description:
An id of a texture, sound or structure in the project's namespace that no Texture, Sound or Structure call in the project provides. The pack still loads, but the file must come from another pack.

Default: `warning`.
external-asset.markdownDescription:
An id of a texture, sound or structure in the project's namespace that no Texture, Sound or Structure call in the project provides. The pack still loads, but the file must come from another pack.

Default: `warning`.

jigsaw-facing.description:
A jigsaw block that can never join its target: every jigsaw block with its target name in its pool faces a way it cannot meet. The game turns pieces only about the y axis, so a block facing up joins only one facing down, and a sideways block only a sideways one.

Default: `warning`.
jigsaw-facing.markdownDescription:
A jigsaw block that can never join its target: every jigsaw block with its target name in its pool faces a way it cannot meet. The game turns pieces only about the y axis, so a block facing up joins only one facing down, and a sideways block only a sideways one.

Default: `warning`.

jigsaw-fit.description:
An internal jigsaw block (the block in front of it is inside its own piece, such as an arch mount on a road, or a jigsaw inset by a block by mistake) whose pool has pieces that stick out of the piece however they are turned. The game only places a piece joined at an internal jigsaw wholly inside its parent, so those pieces are never placed there. Height is not checked for terrain_matching pieces.

Default: `warning`.
jigsaw-fit.markdownDescription:
An internal jigsaw block (the block in front of it is inside its own piece, such as an arch mount on a road, or a jigsaw inset by a block by mistake) whose pool has pieces that stick out of the piece however they are turned. The game only places a piece joined at an internal jigsaw wholly inside its parent, so those pieces are never placed there. Height is not checked for terrain_matching pieces.

Default: `warning`.

jigsaw-hole.description:
A jigsaw block in a structure file that Structure("...") includes whose name or target is in a namespace with JigsawHole declarations, but is not one of them: most likely a typo made in the game's jigsaw screen. The quick fix declares it. Projects that declare no JigsawHole in a namespace are not checked there.

Default: `warning`.
jigsaw-hole.markdownDescription:
A jigsaw block in a structure file that Structure("...") includes whose name or target is in a namespace with JigsawHole declarations, but is not one of them: most likely a typo made in the game's jigsaw screen. The quick fix declares it. Projects that declare no JigsawHole in a namespace are not checked there.

Default: `warning`.

jigsaw-overlap.description:
A jigsaw block that can never grow when its piece joins a given parent: every piece its pool and the pool's fallback could place there overlaps the parent or the piece itself, however it is turned, and the game never places overlapping pieces. A junction narrower than the roads around it is the usual cause. Only certain cases are reported: every piece involved is a rigid project structure file with a known size and facing, and no pool involved has an empty or feature element.

Default: `info`.
jigsaw-overlap.markdownDescription:
A jigsaw block that can never grow when its piece joins a given parent: every piece its pool and the pool's fallback could place there overlaps the parent or the piece itself, however it is turned, and the game never places overlapping pieces. A junction narrower than the roads around it is the usual cause. Only certain cases are reported: every piece involved is a rigid project structure file with a known size and facing, and no pool involved has an empty or feature element.

Default: `info`.

jigsaw-pool.description:
A jigsaw block in a structure file that Structure("...") includes draws from a pool in the project's namespace that no TemplatePool declares. The game skips the jigsaw, so the structure stops growing there. The quick fix declares the pool.

Default: `warning`.
jigsaw-pool.markdownDescription:
A jigsaw block in a structure file that Structure("...") includes draws from a pool in the project's namespace that no TemplatePool declares. The game skips the jigsaw, so the structure stops growing there. The quick fix declares the pool.

Default: `warning`.

jigsaw-target.description:
A jigsaw block whose target no piece of its pool can join: none of the pool's structure files has a jigsaw block with that name, or the pool has no pieces. Only pools whose pieces are all the project's own structure files are checked.

Default: `warning`.
jigsaw-target.markdownDescription:
A jigsaw block whose target no piece of its pool can join: none of the pool's structure files has a jigsaw block with that name, or the pool has no pieces. Only pools whose pieces are all the project's own structure files are checked.

Default: `warning`.

overrides-vanilla.description:
A declaration in the minecraft namespace replaces the vanilla resource with the same id.

Default: `info`.
overrides-vanilla.markdownDescription:
A declaration in the minecraft namespace replaces the vanilla resource with the same id.

Default: `info`.

quoted-name.description:
An id or enum name in quotes can be written bare: `minecraft:stone` or `stone` rather than "minecraft:stone".

Default: `hint`.
quoted-name.markdownDescription:
An id or enum name in quotes can be written bare: `minecraft:stone` or `stone` rather than "minecraft:stone".

Default: `hint`.

redundant-namespace.description:
A `minecraft:` prefix that can be dropped: `stone` means `minecraft:stone` unless the project declares its own `stone`.

Default: `hint`.
redundant-namespace.markdownDescription:
A `minecraft:` prefix that can be dropped: `stone` means `minecraft:stone` unless the project declares its own `stone`.

Default: `hint`.

unused.description:
A worldgen piece, predicate or item modifier that nothing in the project references, so the game never uses it. A TemplatePool counts as used when a jigsaw block in one of the project's structure files draws from it.

Default: `hint`.
unused.markdownDescription:
A worldgen piece, predicate or item modifier that nothing in the project references, so the game never uses it. A TemplatePool counts as used when a jigsaw block in one of the project's structure files draws from it.

Default: `hint`.

unused-asset.description:
A .png, .ogg or .nbt file in the project that no Texture, Sound or Structure call and no `icon` uses, so the packs leave it out. It is reported on the file itself (in VS Code's Problems panel, by `mms check`, and in the web editor's asset list), and not while the project has errors.

Default: `info`.
unused-asset.markdownDescription:
A .png, .ogg or .nbt file in the project that no Texture, Sound or Structure call and no `icon` uses, so the packs leave it out. It is reported on the file itself (in VS Code's Problems panel, by `mms check`, and in the web editor's asset list), and not while the project has errors.

Default: `info`.

use-shorthand.description:
An object literal that has a shorter MMS form: an item entry as its id, `1..3` for a uniform provider or bounds, `diamond * 4` for a stack, a trigger call for a criterion, and `&&`, `||` and `!` for conditions.

Default: `hint`.
use-shorthand.markdownDescription:
An object literal that has a shorter MMS form: an item entry as its id, `1..3` for a uniform provider or bounds, `diamond * 4` for a stack, a trigger call for a criterion, and `&&`, `||` and `!` for conditions.

Default: `hint`.

namespace.description: The default namespace for files without a `Namespace` declaration.
namespace.markdownDescription: The default namespace for files without a `Namespace` declaration.
namespace.patternErrorMessage: A namespace is lowercase letters, digits, '_', '-' or '.'.

output.description: The folder `mms build` writes the data pack to, relative to the project.
output.markdownDescription: The folder `mms build` writes the data pack to, relative to the project.

resourcePack.description: Settings for the resource pack `mms build` writes when the project uses `Texture`, `Sound` or other resource pack declarations.
resourcePack.markdownDescription: Settings for the resource pack `mms build` writes when the project uses `Texture`, `Sound` or other resource pack declarations.

description.description: The resource pack's description. The default is the data pack's `description`.
description.markdownDescription: The resource pack's description. The default is the data pack's `description`.

output.description: The folder `mms build` writes the resource pack to, relative to the project. The default is the data pack's `output` with `-resources` appended.
output.markdownDescription: The folder `mms build` writes the resource pack to, relative to the project. The default is the data pack's `output` with `-resources` appended.

sources.description: Glob patterns for the project's .mms files, relative to the project; `**` matches any number of folders. The default is every .mms file (`**/*.mms`), skipping the output folders, hidden folders and `node_modules`.
sources.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for the project's .mms files, relative to the project; `**` matches any number of folders. The default is every .mms file (`**/*.mms`), skipping the output folders, hidden folders and `node_modules`.

items.description: A glob relative to the project: `*` matches within a folder, `**` any number of folders and `?` one character.
items.markdownDescription: A glob relative to the project: `*` matches within a folder, `**` any number of folders and `?` one character.

enumDescriptions: Report as an error; `mms build` fails.
Report as a hint (shown faintly in editors).
